annotations.title: Help first: useful answer with sourced facts

description: Use FIRST for any message where the person wants a lawyer or legal help, including vague ones like "I need a lawyer". Pass the person's latest words and earlier turns. Returns immediate useful help, up to five listed lawyers when the matter and state are known (in the listing's own order), county free legal aid and court self-help with sources and checked dates, lawyer-published fees before any survey statistic, the official license-check site, and at most one question. Say the help first; ask the one question last. Never says a message was sent; sends nothing.

approved_preview_id.description: Only the id of a preview the person explicitly approved in preview_client_message. Never set from general chat.

attorney_id.description: A listed lawyer the conversation is about (for fees or license), if known.

history.description: Earlier turns of this conversation, oldest first, so facts the person already gave are not asked again.

message.description: The person's latest message, in their own words.
